keyword.en: rural diesel pump vs diesel 30 concrete pump
keyword.zh: 农村柴油泵和柴油30的区别

title.zh: 农村柴油泵和柴油30混凝土泵有何不同

description.en: The rural pump prints 17 kW and 5–8 m³/h. Diesel 30 prints engine 4105 / 56 kW and 15 m³/h.
description.zh: 农村泵印 17 kW 和 5–8 m³/h。柴油30印发动机 4105 / 56 kW 和 15 m³/h。

h1.zh: 农村柴油泵和柴油30混凝土泵有何不同

directAnswer.en: The rural diesel pump and Diesel 30 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. The rural page prints 17 kW, 5–8 m³/h, 15 MPa, horizontal 30–50 m and vertical 10–30 m. Diesel 30 prints 4105 / 56 kW, 15 m³/h, 20 MPa and distance 60 m / 180 m. The rural page has no 4105 code. Diesel 30's distance is one pair, not a hyphenated range.
directAnswer.zh: 农村柴油泵和柴油30是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。农村页印 17 kW、5–8 m³/h、15 MPa、水平 30–50 m、垂直 10–30 m。柴油30印 4105 / 56 kW、15 m³/h、20 MPa、距离 60 m / 180 m。农村页没有 4105 代号。柴油30的距离是一组数，不是用连字符表示的范围。

heading.en: Where Rural diesel pump and Diesel 30 print different values
heading.zh: 农村柴油泵和柴油30哪些数值不同

body.en: Diesel engine power: Rural diesel pump prints 17 kW; Diesel 30 prints 4105 / 56 kW. Theoretical output: Rural diesel pump prints 5–8 m³/h; Diesel 30 prints 15 m³/h. Max. aggregate size: Rural diesel pump prints 1–3 cm; Diesel 30 prints 3 cm and below. Hopper capacity: Rural diesel pump prints 0.2 m³; Diesel 30 prints 0.3 m³. Dimensions: Rural diesel pump prints 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm; Diesel 30 prints 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 柴油机功率：农村柴油泵印 17 kW；柴油30印 4105 / 56 kW。理论输送量：农村柴油泵印 5–8 m³/h；柴油30印 15 m³/h。最大骨料粒径：农村柴油泵印 1–3 cm；柴油30印 3 cm and below。料斗容积：农村柴油泵印 0.2 m³；柴油30印 0.3 m³。外形尺寸：农村柴油泵印 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm；柴油30印 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: Rural diesel pump prints cells that Diesel 30 does not: Pumping pressure 15 MPa; Horizontal delivery distance 30–50 m; Vertical delivery height 10–30 m; Total weight 800 kg. Diesel 30 prints cells that Rural diesel pump does not: Max. outlet pressure 20 MPa; Pumping distance (H / V) 60 m / 180 m; Main unit weight 2000 kg. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: 农村柴油泵有、柴油30没有的行：泵送压力 15 MPa；水平输送距离 30–50 m；垂直输送高度 10–30 m；整机重量 800 kg。柴油30有、农村柴油泵没有的行：最大出口压力 20 MPa；输送距离（水平/垂直） 60 m / 180 m；整机重量 2000 kg。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: A diesel category label covers both a 17 kW compact row and a 56 kW trailer row. Open /en/products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump/ for Rural diesel pump and /en/products/diesel-30-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 30. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 柴油分类同时包含 17 kW 的紧凑行和 56 kW 的拖泵行。看农村柴油泵请打开 /zh/products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump/，看柴油30请打开 /zh/products/diesel-30-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Rural diesel pump print the same diesel engine power as Diesel 30?
question.zh: 农村柴油泵和柴油30的柴油机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. Rural diesel pump prints 17 kW. Diesel 30 prints 4105 / 56 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。农村柴油泵印 17 kW。柴油30印 4105 / 56 kW。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Rural diesel pump print the same theoretical output as Diesel 30?
question.zh: 农村柴油泵和柴油30的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Rural diesel pump prints 5–8 m³/h. Diesel 30 prints 15 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。农村柴油泵印 5–8 m³/h。柴油30印 15 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Rural diesel pump print the same max. aggregate size as Diesel 30?
question.zh: 农村柴油泵和柴油30的最大骨料粒径一样吗？

answer.en: No. Rural diesel pump prints 1–3 cm. Diesel 30 prints 3 cm and below. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。农村柴油泵印 1–3 cm。柴油30印 3 cm and below。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is pumping pressure missing on Diesel 30?
question.zh: 为什么柴油30没有泵送压力？

answer.en: The Diesel 30 page does not print that label. Rural diesel pump prints 15 MPa. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: 柴油30这一页没有印这个标题。农村柴油泵印的是 15 MPa。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。
